==================
Pattern not binds before and, then or
==================

result = x is not 1 and not 2 or not 3;

---

(compilation_unit
  (global_statement
    (expression_statement
      (assignment_expression
        (identifier)
        (is_pattern_expression
          (identifier)
          (or_pattern
            (and_pattern
              (negated_pattern (constant_pattern (integer_literal)))
              (negated_pattern (constant_pattern (integer_literal))))
            (negated_pattern (constant_pattern (integer_literal)))))))))

==================
Pattern not keeps arithmetic inside its constant operands
==================

result = x is not 1 + 2 and not 3 * 4;

---

(compilation_unit
  (global_statement
    (expression_statement
      (assignment_expression
        (identifier)
        (is_pattern_expression
          (identifier)
          (and_pattern
            (negated_pattern
              (constant_pattern
                (binary_expression (integer_literal) (integer_literal))))
            (negated_pattern
              (constant_pattern
                (binary_expression (integer_literal) (integer_literal))))))))))
